p: whirlwind: That his words might have greater majesty, and that Job might know with whom he had to do.
darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge: Which by seeking out the secret counsel of God by man's reason, makes it more obscure, and shows his own folly.
will demand of thee: Because he wished to dispute with God, Job 23:3, God reasons with him, to declare his rashness.

laid the foundations of the earth: Seeing he could not judge those things which were done so long before he was born, he was not able to comprehend all God's works: much less the secret causes of his judgments.
sang together: The stars and dumb creatures are said to praise God, because his power, wisdom and goodness is manifest and known in it.
sons of God shouted for joy: Meaning the angels.
swaddlingband for it: As though the great sea was but as a little baby in the hands of God to turn to and fro.
stayed: That is, God's decree and commandment as in Job 38:10.
morning since thy days: That is, to rise, since you were born?
shaken out of it: Who having in the night been given to wickedness, cannot abide the light, but hide themselves.
and they stand as a garment: The earth which seemed in the night to have no form by the rising of the sun, is as it were created anew, and all things in it clad with new beauty.
depth: If you are not able to seek out the depth of the sea, how much less are you able to comprehend the counsel of God?
shouldest take it to the bound: That you might appoint its highways and limits.
against the time of trouble: To punish my enemies with them, Ex 9:18, Jos 10:11.
as with a stone: The ice covers it, as though it were paved with stone.
of Pleiades: Which rise when the sun is in Taurus, which is the spring, and brings flowers.
Orion: Which comes in winter.
Mazzaroth in his season: Certain stars so called, some think they were the twelve signs.
Arcturus with his sons: The north star with those that are about him.
dominion thereof in the earth: Can you cause the heavenly bodies to have any power over the earthly bodies?
inward parts: In the secret parts of man.
bottles of heaven: That is, the clouds in which the water is contained as in bottles.
and the clods cleave fast together: For when God does not open these bottles, the earth comes to this inconvenience.
thou hunt the prey for the: After he had declared God's works in the heavens, he shows his marvellous providence in earth, even toward the brute beasts.
cry unto God: Read Ps 147:9.
